svg.title: Underhood
svg.desc: Underhood, a free Claude Code skill pack: pop the hood on any game you own. Five steps: recon, dig, forge, art, ship. Token-lean, free local tools, MIT. An isometric game console with its lid propped open on a rod shows a glowing processor, decompiled code lifting out of it, a magnifier reading the bytes 4D 5A on a chip, and a cabled gamepad.

g.text: Pop the hood on any game you own.
Read it. Mod it. Prove it in game.
